en.headline: SFC orders suspension of Cloudbreak Pharma shares
en.dek: Trading in the clinical-stage ophthalmology biotech was halted from 9am under Securities and Futures Ordinance rules; the stock had fallen about 88 per cent since its July 2025 listing.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission directed the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong to suspend trading in Cloudbreak Pharma Inc. (02592) from 9am on Thursday under section 8(1) of the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules.

The clinical-stage ophthalmology biotechnology company last traded at HK$1.19, down about 88 per cent from its July 2025 listing price of HK$10.10. It raised about HK$522 million net in its initial public offering, according to market reports.

The SFC order indicates concern that documents connected with the company may contain false, incomplete or misleading information. Several other small-cap stocks were also briefly halted around the same time, market sources said.
Cloudbreak Pharma focuses on therapeutic biologics for eye conditions. The company has not yet issued a detailed response to the suspension order.

zh.headline: 證監會指令撥康視雲停牌
zh.dek: 臨床階段眼科生物科技公司撥康視雲（02592）今早9時起按證監會指令停止買賣，股價自去年7月上市以來已累挫約88%。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會根據《證券及期貨（在證券市場上市）規則》第8(1)條，指令香港聯合交易所自今日上午9時起停止撥康視雲製藥有限公司（02592）股份買賣。
該臨床階段眼科生物科技公司停牌前報1.19港元，較去年7月上市價10.10港元累跌約88%。公司當年集資淨額約5.22億港元。
證監會指令顯示關注公司相關文件可能載有虛假、不完整或具誤導性的資料。市場消息指，另有數隻細價股同期短暫停止買賣。
撥康視雲專注眼科治療性生物製劑研發。公司暫未就停牌指令發表詳細回應。
